# RPC client options

Authoritative catalog of ores RPC client chaining options. Method names in each target language are derived deterministically from option_id; they are never authored per language. Unary chains terminate in make_call; streaming chains terminate in stream.

Catalog version `1.0.0`. All calls are carried over `POST /v1/rpc`.

## Two client surfaces

The unary client and the streaming client are separate types. A chain terminates in `make_call` or in `stream`, never in both: the terminal method is the only network boundary on its surface, and neither builder exposes the other's terminal.

| Surface | Terminal | Options reachable |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Unary | `make_call`, `make_call_or_throw` | 47 |
| Streaming | `stream` | 45 |
| Shared by both | — | 38 |

## Contradiction-free by construction

Options in an exclusive group are one-way doors. Selecting one returns a narrowed builder type that no longer carries any member of that group, so a contradictory second selection is a compile error rather than a runtime check.

| Group | Members | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `auth_mode` | `omit_auth`, `with_bearer_token` | none | Per-call credential handling. Choosing one narrows the builder so the other cannot be typed. |
| `ip_version` | `force_ipv4`, `force_ipv6` | none | Address-family pin for this request only. |
| `rate_limit` | `debounce`, `throttle` | none | Unary outbound rate shaping. throttle and debounce are contradictory, so at most one is reachable. |
| `serialization` | `use_json`, `use_message_pack`, `use_protobuf`, `use_serial_strategy` | `use_json` | Wire serialization strategy. Selecting one narrows the builder type so a second selection cannot be typed. |
| `stream_rate_limit` | `debounce_each`, `sample_each`, `throttle_each` | none | Inbound item rate shaping for streams. sample, throttle and debounce are contradictory. |

## Options by group

### auth

| Option | Surface | Repeatable | Signature | Plan field | Wire effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `omit_auth` | both | no | `omit_auth() -> self` | `auth_mode` = `omitted` | drops `authorization` |
| `with_bearer_token` | both | no | `with_bearer_token(token: secret_string) -> self` | `auth_mode` = `bearer_override` | `authorization: Bearer {token}` |

- `omit_auth` — Drop the client's default Authorization header for this call only.
- `with_bearer_token` — Override the client's default credential for this call only. The token is redacted in plans, logs and debug output.
  - Carries a credential. It is redacted from request plans, debug output and logs.

### cache

| Option | Surface | Repeatable | Signature | Plan field | Wire effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `require_fresh` | both | no | `require_fresh() -> self` | `require_fresh` = `true` | `cache-control: no-cache`; `pragma: no-cache` |
| `skip_cache` | both | no | `skip_cache() -> self` | `skip_local_cache` = `true` | — |
| `skip_cloudflare_cache` | both | no | `skip_cloudflare_cache() -> self` | `skip_edge_cache` = `true` | `cache-control: no-store`; `cf-cache-status: BYPASS` |
| `stale_while_revalidate` | unary | no | `stale_while_revalidate(seconds: u32) -> self` | `stale_while_revalidate_seconds` | `cache-control: stale-while-revalidate={seconds}` |
| `with_cache_ttl` | unary | no | `with_cache_ttl(seconds: u32) -> self` | `cache_ttl_seconds` | — |

- `require_fresh` — Bust intermediate proxy and CDN caches for this call.
- `skip_cache` — Bypass the client-side response cache and always open the network.
- `skip_cloudflare_cache` — Ask the CDN edge to bypass its cache for this call.
- `stale_while_revalidate` — Serve the cached receipt immediately and refresh it in the background.
- `with_cache_ttl` — Cache the receipt locally for this many seconds to collapse duplicate outbound calls.

### concurrency

| Option | Surface | Repeatable | Signature | Plan field | Wire effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `concurrency_key` | both | no | `concurrency_key(key: string) -> self` | `concurrency_key` | client-local |
| `dedupe` | unary | no | `dedupe() -> self` | `dedupe` = `true` | client-local |
| `drop_if_busy` | both | no | `drop_if_busy() -> self` | `drop_if_busy` = `true` | client-local |
| `queue_priority` | both | no | `queue_priority(priority: queue_priority) -> self` | `queue_priority` | `x-ores-queue-priority: {priority}` |

- `concurrency_key` — Serialize this call against every other call sharing the same named queue.
- `dedupe` — Join an identical in-flight call instead of opening a second socket. Both callers receive the same receipt.
- `drop_if_busy` — Fail immediately rather than queue when the outbound queue is saturated. For telemetry where dropping beats memory pressure.
- `queue_priority` — Order this call inside the client's outbound queue. Higher drains first.

### flow

| Option | Surface | Repeatable | Signature | Plan field | Wire effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `add_jitter` | both | no | `add_jitter(millis: u32) -> self` | `jitter_millis` | client-local |
| `debounce` | unary | no | `debounce(millis: u32) -> self` | `debounce_millis` | client-local |
| `delay` | both | no | `delay(millis: u32) -> self` | `delay_millis` | client-local |
| `throttle` | unary | no | `throttle(millis: u32) -> self` | `throttle_millis` | client-local |

- `add_jitter` — Add a uniform random delay up to this bound, to break up thundering herds.
- `debounce` — Send only after the caller has been quiet for this interval. Keyed by operation plus concurrency_key.
- `delay` — Hold the outbound call for a fixed interval before sending.
- `throttle` — Emit the leading call in each window and discard the rest. Keyed by operation plus concurrency_key.

- `dry_run` — Validate payload, headers and authorization server-side without executing the mutation.
- `with_span_id` — Attach the parent span id for this call.
- `with_trace_id` — Attach a distributed trace id, propagated on the envelope and copied to the receipt.

### resilience

| Option | Surface | Repeatable | Signature | Plan field | Wire effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `on_retry` | both | yes | `on_retry(callback: (attempt: u8, cause: error) -> void) -> self` | `retry_hook_count` | client-local |
| `with_deadline` | both | no | `with_deadline(unix_millis: i64) -> self` | `deadline_unix_millis` | `x-ores-deadline: {unix_millis}` |
| `with_fallback` | unary | no | `with_fallback(value: json) -> self` | `fallback` | — |
| `with_retries` | both | no | `with_retries(count: u8) -> self` | `retry_count` | — |
| `with_retry_backoff` | both | no | `with_retry_backoff(base_millis: u32, factor: f64) -> self` | `retry_backoff` | — |
| `with_timeout` | both | no | `with_timeout(millis: u32) -> self` | `timeout_millis` | — |

- `on_retry` — Observe each retry attempt without changing the outcome.
- `with_deadline` — Abort at an absolute wall-clock instant and advertise it to the server.
- `with_fallback` — Resolve with this value instead of failing when the call exhausts its retries.
- `with_retries` — Retry budget for this call. Only admitted on operations declared idempotent.
- `with_retry_backoff` — Exponential backoff schedule applied between retries.
- `with_timeout` — Abort this call locally after the given elapsed time.

### serialization

| Option | Surface | Repeatable | Signature | Plan field | Wire effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `use_json` | both | no | `use_json() -> self` | `serial_strategy` = `json` | `accept: application/json`; `content-type: application/json` |
| `use_message_pack` | both | no | `use_message_pack() -> self` | `serial_strategy` = `message_pack` | `accept: application/msgpack`; `content-type: application/msgpack` |
| `use_protobuf` | both | no | `use_protobuf() -> self` | `serial_strategy` = `protobuf` | `accept: application/x-protobuf`; `content-type: application/x-protobuf` |
| `use_serial_strategy` | both | no | `use_serial_strategy(strategy: serial_strategy) -> self` | `serial_strategy` | header from the selected `serial_strategy` variant's `content_type` (3 variants) |

- `use_json` — Serialize the envelope as JSON. Default when no strategy is chosen.
- `use_message_pack` — Serialize the envelope as MessagePack.
- `use_protobuf` — Serialize the envelope as protobuf using the operation's frozen descriptor.
- `use_serial_strategy` — Select the serialization strategy from a value instead of a dedicated method.

### stream_flow

| Option | Surface | Repeatable | Signature | Plan field | Wire effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `debounce_each` | stream | no | `debounce_each(millis: u32) -> self` | `debounce_each_millis` | client-local |
| `sample_each` | stream | no | `sample_each(millis: u32) -> self` | `sample_each_millis` | client-local |
| `throttle_each` | stream | no | `throttle_each(millis: u32) -> self` | `throttle_each_millis` | client-local |
| `with_backpressure` | stream | no | `with_backpressure(strategy: backpressure) -> self` | `backpressure` | client-local |
| `with_stream_buffer` | stream | no | `with_stream_buffer(capacity: u32) -> self` | `stream_buffer_capacity` | client-local |
| `with_stream_idle_timeout` | stream | no | `with_stream_idle_timeout(millis: u32) -> self` | `stream_idle_timeout_millis` | client-local |

- `debounce_each` — Emit an item only after the producer has been quiet for this interval.
- `sample_each` — Emit the most recent item once per interval.
- `throttle_each` — Emit the leading item in each interval and drop the rest.
- `with_backpressure` — Decide what happens when the consumer falls behind the producer.
- `with_stream_buffer` — Bound the number of buffered inbound items before the backpressure strategy applies.
- `with_stream_idle_timeout` — Fail the stream when no frame arrives for this long. Distinct from the total-call timeout.

### terminal

| Option | Surface | Repeatable | Signature | Plan field | Wire effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `make_call` | unary | no | `make_call() -> outcome_tuple` | — | — |
| `make_call_or_throw` | unary | no | `make_call_or_throw() -> value` | — | — |
| `stream` | stream | no | `stream() -> stream_client` | — | — |
| `to_plan` | both | yes | `to_plan() -> request_plan` | — | — |

- `make_call` — Execute the unary call and resolve to a (value, context) outcome. The sole network boundary of the unary client.
- `make_call_or_throw` — Execute the unary call and raise on a failed receipt instead of returning a context.
- `stream` — Open the streaming call and resolve to an async-iterable, observable-backed stream client. The sole network boundary of the streaming client.
- `to_plan` — Serialize the accumulated chain to a canonical request plan without opening the network. Used by cross-language conformance and by dry documentation.

### transport

| Option | Surface | Repeatable | Signature | Plan field | Wire effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `force_ipv4` | both | no | `force_ipv4() -> self` | `ip_version` = `v4` | client-local |
| `force_ipv6` | both | no | `force_ipv6() -> self` | `ip_version` = `v6` | client-local |
| `keep_alive` | both | no | `keep_alive(enabled: bool) -> self` | `keep_alive` | `connection: {enabled:keep-alive|close}` |
| `skip_tls_verify` | both | no | `skip_tls_verify() -> self` | `skip_tls_verify` = `true` | client-local |
| `use_new_agent` | both | no | `use_new_agent() -> self` | `new_agent` = `true` | client-local |
| `via_proxy` | both | no | `via_proxy(url: url) -> self` | `proxy_url` | client-local |

- `force_ipv4` — Pin address-family resolution to IPv4 for this call.
- `force_ipv6` — Pin address-family resolution to IPv6 for this call.
- `keep_alive` — Override connection pooling. Disabling closes the socket immediately after the receipt.
- `skip_tls_verify` — Disable strict TLS validation for this call. Refused unless the client was constructed with the insecure_local_dev capability.
  - Refused unless the client declares the `insecure_local_dev` capability.
- `use_new_agent` — Open this call on a fresh connection pool instead of the shared agent.
- `via_proxy` — Route only this call through the given proxy.
